record.content: The Inyo National Forest page describes Upper Pine Grove as a 9-site campground along Rock Creek in tall Jeffrey pines, with some flatter sites for easier accessibility. It is first-come, first-served with self-registration; limits stays to 14 days; provides vault toilets, bear boxes, potable water, and picnic tables; has no electrical hookups; and publishes coordinates 37.4691,-118.7254 and elevation 9,400 feet.
